en.html:
《Between life and death, laugh at yourself until the self is forgotten in ecstasy.》
《Then let dawn's lament become the bell, and raise the curtain upon the divine comedy.》
en.text:
《Between life and death, laugh at yourself until the self is forgotten in ecstasy.》
《Then let dawn's lament become the bell, and raise the curtain upon the divine comedy.》

ja.html:
《生と死の狭間に己を笑い恍惚として自ら忘るる》
《されば夜明けの嘆きを鐘に神曲の幕よいざ上がれ》
ja.text:
《生と死の狭間に己を笑い恍惚として自ら忘るる》
《されば夜明けの嘆きを鐘に神曲の幕よいざ上がれ》

en.html:
《The saint who performs miracles saves mankind, curses God, and vomits.》
《The conqueror in the golden helm wins ten thousand miles and sinks beneath the river with his beloved horse.》
《The beauty of the lake abandons her kingdom for love, then drowns in filth and dies condemned.》
《The orphaned infant drinks earthworm blood as mother's milk and rots from the belly after three nights.》
en.text:

《The conqueror in the golden helm wins ten thousand miles and sinks beneath the river with his beloved horse.》
《The beauty of the lake abandons her kingdom for love, then drowns in filth and dies condemned.》
《The orphaned infant drinks earthworm blood as mother's milk and rots from the belly after three nights.》

ja.html:
《奇跡を行う聖人は衆生を救い神を呪って嘔吐する》
《黄金の兜の覇王は万里を征し愛馬と共に川底へ沈む》
《湖の美姫は国を捨て愛を選び糞尿に溺れて刑死する》
《孤赤児は蚯蚓の血を母の乳とし三夜して腹より腐る》

《孤赤児は蚯蚓の血を母の乳とし三夜して腹より腐る》

en.html:
《O life, hear this anthem: grievance piled upon laughter exhausted from laughing.》
《O life, hear this prayer: joy trembling with anger beneath its head.》
《A hundred-year life may wear rings of fire and swords as decoration.》
《A seven-day life may shine innocent, guarded by darkness and silence.》
《O beast, dance! Run the fields! Sing, shout, rage and roam!》
《Every chain and every cage before you is now only crumbling mud.》
en.text:
《O life, hear this anthem: grievance piled upon laughter exhausted from laughing.》
《O life, hear this prayer: joy trembling with anger beneath its head.》
《A hundred-year life may wear rings of fire and swords as decoration.》
《A seven-day life may shine innocent, guarded by darkness and silence.》
《O beast, dance! Run the fields! Sing, shout, rage and roam!》
《Every chain and every cage before you is now only crumbling mud.》

ja.html:
《生命よこの賛歌を聞け笑い疲れた怨嗟を重ねて》
《生命よこの祈りを聞け怒りおののく喜びを枕に》
《百年の生は炎と剣の連環が幾重にも飾り立てよう》
《七日の生は闇と静寂に守られ無垢に光り輝くだろう》
《獣よ踊れ野を馳せよ唄い騒いで猛り駆けめぐれ》
《いまや如何なる鎖も檻も汝の前には朽ちた土塊》
